title: MMO Economies - Hyperinflation, Reserve Currencies & You! - Extra Credits
summary: An Extra Credits episode on how MMO economies get overrun by inflation when players can mint unlimited gold by killing monsters. It covers approaches borrowed from real-world economics, such as anchoring or pegging currency, as alternatives to simple gold sinks.
why: Cited in game-economy threads as a clear explanation of why vendor-sellable loot causes hyperinflation and how designers counter it.

quote.text: Extra creditz just published an excellent video on why auto-generated vendor-sellable items lead to hyperinflation under most circumstances
